mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_requests (from_user_id, to_user_id, status, create_time) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 0, handle_time = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend_requests WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE friend_requests SET status = 1, handle_time = NOW() WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND status = 0
UPDATE friend_requests SET status = 2, handle_time = NOW() WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND status = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO friend_relations (user_id, friend_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{friendId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM friend_relations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND friend_id = #{friendId}
mapper.update: UPDATE friend_requests SET status = 2, handle_time = NOW() WHERE ((from_user_id = #{userId} AND to_user_id = #{friendId}) OR (from_user_id = #{friendId} AND to_user_id = #{userId})) AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.status, (SELECT c.id FROM conversations c JOIN conversation_members m1 ON m1.conversation_id = c.id AND m1.user_id = u.id JOIN conversation_members m2 ON m2.conversation_id = c.id AND m2.user_id = #{userId} WHERE c.type = 1 LIMIT 1) AS conversation_id FROM users u JOIN friend_relations r ON (r.user_id = #{userId} AND u.id = r.friend_id) OR (r.friend_id = #{userId} AND u.id = r.user_id) order by u.id limit #{size} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from friend_relations r where r.user_id = #{userId} or r.friend_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.status, r.create_time FROM friend_requests r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.from_user_id WHERE r.to_user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
